content.text: {"headline":"Approve R2 (whole-window break delays, callbacks and chat on both queues, no overtime) for Rs 1,164, and bring in the duty manager: it is the best plan within policy but reaches only 67.6% against the 80% target for 13:00-15:00.","why":"General's handle time has roughly doubled since 10:30 (about 345 s to 644-745 s, against a forecast of about 370 s). Call volume is below forecast and sickness is normal, so the likely cause is ticket INC-20261104-2401: knowledge-base search is timing out. The link is likely but not confirmed, because the ticket was opened an hour after handle time rose. With no action, the window is predicted at 45.2% with 14.8% abandons. R2 lifts this to 67.6% with 6.7% abandons and 85.6% for the rest of the day. No plan within policy reaches 80%. Escalation is required because R2 is below the 70% line (ESC-02). The duty manager should decide whether to accept this and should push for a fix to the knowledge-base incident.","trade_offs":["R1 is the only option above 70% (72.9%, General 56.4%, 5.7% abandons) for Rs 2,244, but it breaks overtime rule OT-04. Expected overtime would be Rs 15,264 against today's Rs 15,000 budget, so only the duty manager could approve it.","P3 costs more (Rs 1,524) yet predicts only 61.0%, because its break delays cover just 13:00-14:00. R2 does better for less money.","Even under R2, General stays weak at 45.3% while Payments reaches 85.3%. General's callers carry most of the impact.","P1 costs nothing but barely helps (46.3%). P2 costs Rs 264 and reaches 53.1%, which leaves General at 36.6%.","Delaying breaks across the whole window will strain agents, and break-time cover after 15:00 will need watching."],"watch":"Watch General's handle time and the progress of INC-20261104-2401. If knowledge-base search recovers, service should improve quickly; if handle time stays near 700 s, ask the duty manager about R1's overtime. Also check that chat deflection and callback uptake are actually reducing General's queue."}
